description: The plot illustrates the training loss with respect to iterations for various models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, all of which begin at approximately 3.35 at 0 iterations and exhibit a sharp initial decline before transitioning to a more gradual, steady decrease across the remainder of the x-axis. The "Vanilla" line is light blue and ends at roughly 2.45 at 140000 iterations. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" line is orange and concludes at approximately 2.7 at 140000 iterations. The "SepLLM (n=64)" line is green and finishes near 2.65 at 140000 iterations. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line is red and ends at about 2.6 at 140000 iterations. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line is purple and concludes at approximately 2.55 at 140000 iterations. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=128)" line is brown and also ends near 2.55 at 140000 iterations.
